source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    upper = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    lower = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(divider + 1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    selected_color = max(upper, key=lambda p: p[1])[2]
    selected = [(r, c) for r, c, color in upper if color == selected_color]
    target_color = lower[0][2]
    target = [(r, c) for r, c, color in lower if color == target_color]

    sr0, sc0 = min(r for r, c in selected), min(c for r, c in selected)
    tr0, tc0 = min(r for r, c in target), min(c for r, c in target)
    sr1, sc1 = max(r for r, c in selected), max(c for r, c in selected)
    tr1, tc1 = max(r for r, c in target), max(c for r, c in target)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(9)]
    for r, c in target:
        out[r - 6][c] = target_color
    target_center = (tc0 + tc1) / 2
    selected_center = (sc0 + sc1) / 2
    col_shift = round(target_center - selected_center)
    row_shift = (tr0 - 6) - (sr1 - sr0 + 1) - sr0
    for r, c in selected:
        out[r + row_shift][c + col_shift] = selected_color
    return out
'''
